mapper.select: SELECT a.bmt01_buy_id AS buy_id , a.bmt01_buy_date AS buy_date , a.bmt01_provide_content_cd AS provide_content_code , f_cdnm('ProvideContentCode', a.bmt01_provide_content_cd, a.bmt01_company_id, a.bmt01_buy_date) AS provide_content_name , a.bmt01_buy_qty AS buy_qty , a.bmt01_buy_amt AS buy_amt , (SELECT count(biz02_person_id) FROM biz02_person INNER JOIN biz01_promo ON biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id WHERE biz01_buy_id = a.bmt01_buy_id) AS total_peple , (a.bmt01_buy_amt / a.bmt01_buy_qty) / (SELECT (CASE WHEN COUNT(biz02_person_id) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE COUNT(biz02_person_id) END) FROM biz02_person INNER JOIN biz01_promo ON biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id WHERE biz01_buy_id = a.bmt01_buy_id) AS average_price , (SELECT a.bmt01_buy_qty - count(biz02_person_id) FROM biz02_person INNER JOIN biz01_promo ON biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id WHERE biz01_buy_id = a.bmt01_buy_id) AS left_qty , a.bmt01_person_id AS person_id , f_emp_kor_nm(a.bmt01_person_id) AS person_name , a.bmt01_appr_id AS appr_id , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', b.apr01_status_cd, a.bmt01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS appr_status_name FROM bmt01_buy a LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr b ON b.apr01_appr_id = a.bmt01_appr_id WHERE 1=1 AND bmt01_buy_id = #{buyId} AND bmt01_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bmt01_buy ( bmt01_buy_id, bmt01_company_id, bmt01_reg_emp_id , bmt01_buy_date, bmt01_provide_content_cd, bmt01_buy_qty, bmt01_buy_amt, bmt01_person_id ) VALUES ( #{buyId}, #{companyId}, #{regEmpId} , #{req.buyDate}, #{req.provideContentCode}, #{req.buyQty}, #{req.buyAmt}, #{req.personId} )
